See What Our Massachusetts Customers Have to Say

Choosing a contractor for your property is an important decision. Customer reviews provide valuable insight into what it's like to work with S. Phaneuf & Associates, from the initial consultation through project completion.

Our customer reviews highlight the qualities that matter most when planning a construction or outdoor improvement project, including communication, workmanship, professionalism, reliability, and attention to detail. They also provide examples of the residential and commercial projects we've completed throughout Massachusetts.

Whether you're considering a custom masonry or hardscape project, asphalt paving, excavation and site development, or another construction service, these reviews can help you understand our approach and what you can expect when working with our team.

We encourage you to read through the experiences shared by our customers and see why homeowners, businesses, property managers, and other property owners throughout Massachusetts have trusted S. Phaneuf & Associates with their projects.

Custom Outdoor Living Space Transformation - Concord, MA

Working with S. Phaneuf & Associates was an absolute pleasure from start to finish. We had a vision for our outdoor space, and they brought it to life beyond our expectations. The custom fabricated fire pit and gas torches in Stonewall are the centerpiece of our backyard, creating a cozy and inviting atmosphere for gatherings. The granite stairs leading to our plunge pool add a touch of elegance, while the outdoor kitchen with blue stone countertops makes entertaining a breeze. We also appreciate the attention to detail shown in the separate wood-burning fire pit and the thin veneer fieldstone on our basement walls, which seamlessly blend with the overall design. This kind of detailed and thoughtful hardscaping work exceeded everything we imagined. Throughout the entire process, the team at S. Phaneuf & Associates demonstrated professionalism, expertise, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results. We couldn't be happier with the outcome and would highly recommend them to anyone looking to elevate their outdoor living space. Anonymous - Concord, MA

Driveway Paving and Site Improvements - Maynard, MA

These fellows came over and regraded and asphalted our existing driveway. They also excavated and installed a second driveway for us. In addition, they repaired and stuccoed (refinished with a smooth concrete surface) our existing back stairs. All three tasks were performed with an admirable attention to detail, and for a very decent price. Beyond that, the guys working at my house were really friendly, and polite. Can I just mention, that the stucco job they did on my stairs is really pretty? Not just a job well done, but pretty. The concrete is so finely worked that it resembles fondant icing, it's THAT smooth. That's good work, right there. They do much more than what they did for me — all kinds of hardscaping and stonework. Look to their website. Would I hire them, again? You betcha! Kerri O. - Maynard, MA

Outdoor Kitchen Hardscape Installation - Ashby, MA

Our experience with the installation team was nothing short of remarkable. These professionals were like culinary wizards, transforming raw materials into a functional masterpiece. Their precision and attention to detail left us in awe. And the best part? They worked with the speed of a well-oiled machine. In no time, our dream outdoor kitchen materialized, and they left the area pristine and clean—no dust, no mess. Their flawless execution is a testament to the expert hardscaping capabilities of S. Phaneuf & Associates. Tom M. - Ashby, MA

We specialize in providing expert services throughout Massachusetts. Whether you're looking for masonry, hardscapes, asphalt paving, excavation, or snow and ice management, our team has the experience and expertise to get the job done right.

Frequently Asked Questions

How can I read customer reviews for S. Phaneuf & Associates?

You can read customer reviews and testimonials from homeowners and businesses who have worked with S. Phaneuf & Associates on masonry, hardscaping, asphalt paving, excavation, site development, and other construction projects. Our reviews provide insight into the quality of our workmanship, communication, professionalism, and overall project experience.

What types of projects do customers review?

Our customer reviews cover a variety of residential and commercial projects, including custom patios, outdoor living spaces, fire pits, retaining walls, masonry and hardscaping, asphalt paving, excavation, site development, and other property improvements. The projects featured in our reviews reflect the range of construction services we provide throughout Massachusetts.

Do you work with both residential and commercial customers?

Yes. S. Phaneuf & Associates works with both residential and commercial customers throughout Massachusetts. Our experience includes residential outdoor living and masonry projects as well as commercial paving, site development, excavation, property improvements, and snow and ice management.

Where are your customers located?

Our customers are located throughout Massachusetts, including communities in Greater Boston and Central and Eastern Massachusetts. We have completed projects in communities such as Concord, Holliston, Wellesley, Weston, Acton, Bolton, Carlisle, Lexington, Littleton, Sudbury, Wayland, and Westford. Visit our Service Areas page to learn more about the communities we serve.

How can I learn more about a project mentioned in a review?

Our portfolio includes examples of completed masonry, hardscaping, asphalt paving, excavation, and site development projects. You can explore our Portfolio to see additional project examples, or visit the service page related to the type of project you're interested in.

How can I contact S. Phaneuf & Associates about a similar project?

If you're considering a project similar to one featured in our reviews, contact S. Phaneuf & Associates to discuss your goals and property. You can contact us by phone, email, or through our online form to request a free consultation and estimate.
